arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table" ORDER BY name

SELECT 'pending_booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancels',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'related',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',x.booking_id,'status',x.status)) FROM bookings x WHERE x.client_reference=b.client_reference)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'capacity',capacity,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'fare_hold' AS kind,json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) AS data FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'event_id',e.event_id,'step',e.step) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b USING(request_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('service',service,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12)

SELECT 'integrity' AS kind,json_object('pending_bookings',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'),'confirmed_without_hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND h.booking_id IS NULL),'confirmed_charge_count_wrong',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1),'missing_checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND c.booking_id IS NULL),'cancelled_with_hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled'),'cancelled_with_checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled'),'duplicate_sales',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)),'pending_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'),'wrong_charge_amount',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.amount_cents<>c.amount_cents),'missing_refunds',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(charge_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND c.state='captured' AND (r.refund_id IS NULL OR r.amount_cents<>c.amount_cents))) AS data UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_booking',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'cancellation_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'refunded_cents',(SELECT sum(amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE status='cancelled'
